title: Eigenvalue-Decomposition Cost Denoising as an Alternative to Predict-then-Optimize for Shortest-Path Problems
abstract: arXiv:2609.15111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predict-then-optimize methods such as Smart "Predict, then Optimize" (SPO+) of Elmachtoub and Grigas (2022) learn a mapping from contextual features to unknown edge costs and then solve the induced combinatorial problem on the predicted costs. This approach is powerful but relies on the predictive model being well specified: when the true cost-generating process is nonlinear in the features and the predictor is linear, SPO+'s performance degrades as the misspecification grows. We propose and evaluate a structurally different remedy for a specific but common setting: when the decision-maker observes many noisy realizations of the same underlying cost process, the realized cost vectors themselves can be treated as a noisy signal and denoised directly, via eigenvalue decomposition (equivalently, Principal Component Analysis) of their covariance matrix, before ever invoking a predictive model. We instantiate this idea on the $5\times5$ gri

translated_title: 特征值分解成本去噪：作为最短路径问题中“先预测后优化”方法的替代方案
translated_abstract: 诸如Smart "Predict, then Optimize"（SPO+）（Elmachtoub和Grigas，2022）之类的“先预测后优化”方法学习从上下文特征到未知边成本的映射，然后基于预测的成本求解所诱导的组合问题。这种方法功能强大，但依赖于预测模型被正确设定：当真实的成本生成过程关于特征是非线性的而预测器是线性时，随着误设定程度的增大，SPO+的性能会退化。针对一个特定但常见的场景，我们提出并评估了一种结构上截然不同的补救方法：当决策者观察到同一潜在成本过程的多个含噪实现时，可以在调用任何预测模型之前，将已实现的成本向量本身视为含噪信号，并通过对协方差矩阵进行特征值分解（等价地，主成分分析）来直接去噪。我们在5×5网格（原文在此处截断）上实例化了这一想法……
tldr: 本文提出当决策者能观察到同一成本过程的多个含噪实现时，可直接通过协方差矩阵的特征值分解（PCA）对成本向量去噪，从而在线性预测模型存在误设定的最短路径问题中，替代SPO+等“先预测后优化”方法以避免性能退化。
en_tdlr: When multiple noisy realizations of the same underlying cost process are available, directly denoising cost vectors via eigenvalue decomposition (PCA) of their covariance matrix provides a structurally different alternative to predict-then-optimize methods like SPO+ for shortest-path problems, avoiding performance degradation caused by linear model misspecification.
